family.name: read_file
family.description: Read a text file. Returns its lines numbered from 1. A file over 2000 lines read without offset/limit returns an outline (definitions with line numbers) instead; then read the ranges you need.

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to the workspace

family.name: write_file
family.description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Parent directories are created. New files are private; replacements preserve existing permissions. Read-only and hard-linked targets are refused.

family.name: edit_file
family.description: Replace an exact string in a file. old_string must match exactly once unless replace_all is true. Returns the lines around each replacement as they now read.

old_string.description: Exact text to find (include enough context to be unique)

family.name: list_files
family.description: List files under a directory (recursively, honoring .gitignore). Directories end with '/'.

family.name: grep
family.description: Search file contents with a regular expression (Rust regex syntax). Returns path:line:text matches.

path.description: File or directory to search (default: the workspace)

glob.description: Only files matching this glob, e.g. *.rs

family.name: bash
family.description: Run a shell command with bash in the workspace directory and return its stdout, stderr and exit code. Non-interactive: stdin is closed. Killed after timeout_secs (default 120, max 600).
